text:
I do not recommend this hospital.

I came in because something had bitten me and blood was running down my leg. I wanted a proper examination to understand what had happened, how serious it was, and whether anything was still left in the wound.

Instead, the wound was simply cleaned with antiseptic and covered with a bandage. No real effort was made to identify what caused the injury, no proper examination was performed, and no meaningful explanation was provided.

Then came the bill: more than 4,500 baht.

The invoice included a doctor fee, emergency room nursing fee, OPD service fee, plus charges for gloves, bandages, antiseptic, saline solution, and other supplies. It felt as if every possible item and service had been added to maximize the bill.

I understand that private hospitals charge more, but this felt less like healthcare and more like a money extraction scheme. Charging over 4,500 baht for what was essentially cleaning a wound and applying a bandage is outrageous.3300 from 4600 - just service charges

The most disappointing part is that when you come in worried and needing medical help, you trust that you’re being treated as a patient. Instead, I left feeling like I was being treated as a tourist to be overcharged.

If your insurance does not cover 100% of the cost, I strongly recommend avoiding this hospital. In my experience, the quality of care was nowhere near the price charged, and the entire process felt like an overpriced rip-off designed to squeeze as much money as possible out of patients.

I recently had a medical checkup at Thai International Hospital, and the overall experience was good. The staff were helpful and assisted me throughout the process. The checkup was organized and didn’t take too long, which I appreciated.

Everyone I interacted with was polite and explained the steps clearly, so it was easy to follow what needed to be done. The environment was also clean and comfortable.

Overall, it was a smooth and straightforward experience, and I felt well assisted during my visit. 👍

I was there because of a scooter accident and they took such amazing care of me. My wound was treated very carefully and professionally, and it now looks really good. The staff was incredibly kind and we truly felt comfortable there. Since I had to stay for two nights, I was a bit worried at first, but the rooms were great, the food was really good, and the staff was super friendly. My girlfriend was also allowed to stay overnight with me. I can absolutely recommend this hospital 👍

After our bike accident, we were fortunate to receive care at this hospital. The staff was incredibly reliable. We were quickly transported from the accident site to their emergency room by ambulance. They took all info and proceeded with taking care of us. The hospital was very very clean, which gave us an added sense of comfort during such a stressful time. The doctor and staff were exceptionally reassuring. They adressed all our concerns with patience and professionalism. They took all the necessary steps to provide us with the best care possible, and we are truly grateful for their support during this experience.

We’ve just been here after the hotel told us it was the best hospital in the area. My 2 year old has a cut on his forehead and we were told by our doctor in Italy that he might need glue.

When we got there, the staff outside and reception were super helpful and friendly. But when we got through to emergency, the paramedic was rude and didn’t even look at the wound. Juts told us they don’t have glue but just stitches.

First of all - how can the supposedly best hospital in the island not be able to provide glue in 2026? This seems very odd.

Secondly - if only they took the time to examine my son, they would have found out that he only needed tight sterile strips, clean of the wound and a waterproof plaster.

We ended up to Bangkok Hospital where they saw and us and treated us pretty quickly.

I visited the hospital due to abdominal pain caused by food poisoning. The staff provided prompt and friendly service. The doctor and nurses explained my condition and treatment clearly, which made me feel comfortable and well cared for. I was also pleased to receive a discount through the Family Card, making the overall experience very satisfying.

5 stars is not enough. I'd give it a 10! After living on Samui for 18 years I have seen all hospitals from the inside. The one or other hospital might look a little more modern or fancy but that's only for the eye. When it comes to professional treatment, personal attention and an overall feeling of caring the Thai Inter is unbeatable. Doctors and staff are looking after you really well and the prices are well within range too. I wish good health to everyone and hopefully you will never have to go to any hospital but if you do, I can highly recommend the Thai Inter. Thank you so much for all you did for me over all these years.

absolutely AMAZING place with super helpful doctors!! i was very well cared for over the few days i was in and out, with a super steady recovery- and my wounds didn't ever get infected either, they're very clean and precise!!
Hospitable and very helpful. Specially Pearl she was so sweet and helped us throughout our check ups. So grateful and happy that I chose this Hospital

I came here last night November 3th with my 2-year-old son, burning with 40°C fever that wouldn’t go down. The nurses were great, polite and caring — but the young tomboy doctor wasn't that good. She didn’t barely moved from her chair or …

I mean, it's a hospital. What is there to say?

Went there with high fever and gastro intestinal issues at about 5.30 pm. Personal medical anamnesis was done within 10 minutes of arrival.

Full diagnosis later that evening.

Due to my symptoms a COVID test had to be done as well. The results for this took the longest time of all procedures done.

Nurses and doctors were very friendly and proficient in English. Staff was also helpful in processing everything with and for the travel health insurance.

Did not have to pay a single baht when leaving as the hospital dealt with the insurance for the most part.

Got a room for myself with an extra bed for my girlfriend. TV, fridge, microwave and water kettle in the room. Small snacks and water are included.

Had to stay 3 nights. Nurses available round the clock. Checking on you every few hours. Doctor's visit twice per day.

Meals were ok but you can order outside food.

All in all: a better experience than I ever had in Germany.

Spent two days in hospital for a stomach virus/bacterial infection. Staff are super professional and very good at their jobs. Explained all the steps at each level and always wanted to keep me informed. The nursing staff and doctors are kind, caring and explained everything along the way. Rooms are clean and spacious with TVs and a fridge as well as other amenities.
Food here is great. They will even feed your companion. Check out was smooth and pharmacy explained all the medications I was being given.

No one wants to get sick or injured but if you end up that way, this hospital would be my choice.

My elbow was so badly injured that it required complex surgery to reconstruct it with plates and screws. The entire medical team, and especially the surgeons, performed an extraordinary feat. The reconstruction of such a badly damaged elbow could hardly have been done better. Their expertise, precision, and professionalism were impressive.

I would also like to highlight the excellent initial care I received at the Thal International Hospital on Koh Tao. From the initial treatment to the perfectly organized transfer to Koh Samui, everything was quick, professional, and seamless.

Special thanks also go to all the nurses, caregivers, and staff. The entire team was always friendly, attentive, helpful, and highly dedicated. As a patient, you feel completely at ease from the very first moment and receive outstanding medical and personal care.

The food was also excellent. It was varied, delicious, and of a quality you would expect from a fine restaurant.
